Flow screens

Every screen a resident sees outside the game boards, in the order they meet them. Captured from the running app at the 360 × 780 design canvas. Tap a screen to enlarge it.

any cold start

Plain white brand frame held until i18n and Dexie are ready, for at least 2 s.

/

The way in. Get Started goes to signup, Sign in to the name lookup.

Joining

3Sign up

/signup

Name, age and prescriber. Age is checked but never stored. Continue appears once a prescriber is chosen.

SignupScreen, details step

4Prescriber picker

/signup (sheet)

Modal sheet shared with Settings, so the two lists cannot drift apart.

PrescriberPicker

/signup

The chosen prescriber shows under the button and Continue appears.

SignupScreen, details step

6Welcome

/signup

Confirms name and prescriber with a live clock. Next creates the profile, or signs in to an existing one with the same name.

SignupScreen, confirm step

7Sign in

/signin

Matches a typed name against every profile on the device, by first name or nickname.

SignInScreen

Home

8Home, new day

/app/home

Arriving starts the session, so the three games shown are the three that will be played. The greyed strip is the marquee games not picked today.

HomeScreen

/app/home

Continue returns to the intro of the game in play.

HomeScreen

10Home, day complete

/app/home

Before each game

11Keep Your Brain Active

/app/education

Shown once at the start of a session. Purely informational.

EducationScreen

12Game intro

/app/game/:gameId/intro

Before every session game, and every Free Play game with a skill mapping. Names the domain and the skills it trains, then waits for Continue.

GameIntro

13Game title

/app/game/:gameId/title

The game's splash art with a real PLAY button. One per marquee game - all six are below.

GameTitleScreen

During any game

14Leave this game?

/app/game/:gameId (dialog)

The exit button in the corner of every board asks first. Leaving goes back to Home, which then offers Continue.

GameShell

15Turn upright

any /app route, landscape

Covers the app on a sideways touch device. The screen underneath stays mounted, so a round in progress is not lost.

RotateDevice

After a game

16Score card

/app/game/:gameId/score

After each session game, when the session moves on. Words only, never a number. Scoring is not built yet, so today it is the title, the thank-you and Continue.

ScoreCard

17Session summary

/app/summary

After the third game. Lists the games played with the level reached in each.

SessionSummary

The whole library, open only once the day's session is complete.

FreePlayScreen

Language, text size, sound, prescriber and Switch Profile. Reached from the gear on Home.

SettingsScreen
